messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for `adaptive-routing-v2` canary -> 10% traffic (eu-west). image: inference/adaptive:v2. trigger: staged-rollout.
observability-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 5xx rate increased on /v1/embeddings (eu-west canary pool). p50 latency up from 120ms to 920ms.
incident-bot: Paging oncall (sev3) — increased 5xxs affecting canary traffic. See /incidents/2876543210.
samir: I'm on it. pulling logs from canary hosts now.
lindsey: looking at runtime metrics — KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x on the canary nodes. kernel mismatch message in model runtime logs.
jordan: any config drift? were kernels or quantization toggled in this deploy?
samir: deploy diff shows new kernel selector flag enabled: `enable_kernel_override=true` in the canary config. suspecting mismatch with quantized model shard layout.
carla: canary health checks are flapping, pods in CrashLoopBackoff on two nodes. attaching short log sample:
```
[2024-11-07T14:02:33Z] ERROR runtime: failed to load kernel libquant.so: symbol mismatch
[2024-11-07T14:02:33Z] WARN inference: fallback attempt 1 -> timeout 1000ms
[2024-11-07T14:02:34Z] ERROR api: handler /v1/embeddings -> downstream timeout (model runtime)
```

samir: yep. kernel selector is forcing a kernel that isn't compatible with this quantized checkpoint. causing runtime retries -> increased latency -> upstream 502/504.
jordan: can we flip the feature-flag to kill the canary rule? we should stop routing new traffic to canary hosts.
lindsey: recommended immediate mitigation: 1) flip adaptive-routing-v2 -> off for canary traffic, 2) scale up fallback pool, 3) start rollback if killswitch doesn't clear errors.
samir: issuing killswitch now: `POST /internal/flags/disable adaptive-routing-v2 --env=prod --scope=canary`
deploy-bot: Feature flag `adaptive-routing-v2` set to OFF for canary in eu-west by samir.
observability-bot: Noted: traffic steering disabled. Routing now sending new requests to stable pool. Cache warmup for stable pool in progress.
carla: draining existing canary connections. running: `kubectl drain pod/canary-xyz --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
cs-bot: Heads-up to CS: we have a transient increase in 5xxs for embeddings; likely customer-facing for a subset of EU users. CS on rotation notified.
jordan: still seeing 502s in the last 30s from canary IPs — some retries queued in front proxy. need to purge or let them drain?
lindsey: purge the canary backend from the edge. `edgectl remove-backend canary-eu-west` (do this first).
samir: edge backend removed. initiating rollback to previous revision `inference/adaptive:v1-stable-20241106` as belt-and-suspenders.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for service `inference` -> target image inference/adaptive:v1-stable-20241106. Triggered by samir.
observability-bot: Rolling metrics: error rate began dropping ~22s after routing change; p50 decreasing.
carla: checking pod restarts — canary pods terminating gracefully.
cs-bot: initial customer-impact estimate: ~3% of production embedding requests temporally errored (mostly in eu-west) between 14:02:20Z and 14:04:10Z. Noted customers with increased error rates: org-omega, partner-acme. CS will open incident notices for affected customers.
jordan: log excerpt after rollback start:
```
[2024-11-07T14:04:12Z] INFO deploy: rollback complete, new image running: inference/adaptive:v1-stable-20241106
[2024-11-07T14:04:15Z] INFO runtime: kernel selector reverted to auto, KV cache warming
[2024-11-07T14:04:40Z] INFO api: 200 OK /v1/embeddings (eu-west)
```

observability-bot: Alert resolved: 5xx rate returned to baseline. Incident window ~110s.
samir: root cause: kernel selector flag enabled an incompatible kernel path for this quantized model variant. will make a follow-up PR to add compatibility checks and kill-switch gating.
lindsey: create follow-up ticket with list of affected canary hosts, logs, and rollback timeline. assign to runtime team and tag `safety:deploy` label.
carla: created TICKET-9721: "incompatible-kernel-selector-caused-canary-5xxs" include logs and rollback steps. link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/TICKET-9721
samir: notes for postmortem: - disable kernel override by default - add preflight check: `model_binary.check_abi()` - extend canary observability to detect kernel mismatch quicker.
jordan: any lingering customer action we should take?
cs-bot: CS will notify org-omega and partner-acme with timeline and mitigation. recommend outbound email and status page update.
lindsey: preparing handoff: i'm oncall for next 30 min then @samir takes overnight. summarize current state and follow-ups in the incident ticket.
samir: taking handoff after 30m. current state: stable, rollback complete, no ongoing paging. follow-ups: TICKET-9721 assigned runtime, add e2e test for kernel selection, status page update, CS notifications.
carla: thumbs-up. closing thread and will add timestamps to the ticket. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed (severity: sev3). duration 00:01:50. responders: samir, lindsey, carla, jordan.
cs-bot: statuspage draft: "Partial increase in 5xxs for embeddings in eu-west between 14:02Z-14:04Z due to a canary-only kernel selector config. Traffic routed back to stable revision; rollback completed. Impact limited to small subset of requests. Full postmortem TICKET-9721."
